supporting_text: Histological study confirmed colon endometriosis with transmural involvement causing areas of fibrosis and hemorrhage.
The stenosing area was resected with end-to-end anastomosis, indicating an obstruction caused by endometriosis.
The clinical notes mention hemorrhage related to gastrointestinal conditions.
The patient has a history of hypertension, which may complicate gastrointestinal hemorrhage.
The patient has a history of umbilical hernia, which could be associated with abdominal pain and gastrointestinal symptoms.
The patient presented with abdominal tenderness and pain, both localized in the left lower quadrant.
